scope: Resolve Data24 (Protected land %) from PARTIAL to VERIFIED: perform the spatial join - clip Natura 2000 site polygons (Habitats + Birds) to EL62 (Ionian Islands NUTS2) land, split terrestrial/marine by intersecting the land polygon, union Habitats ∪ Birds, and compute % = protected land ÷ EL62 land area. Verify the EL62 land area against the published figure and confirm completeness (no protected islet missed by a region-code filter). Also resolve Data25 (accommodation in high-value areas) from the EU Tourism Dashboard 2024 release and cross-check Data24 against its protected-land indicator.

evidence.name: NUTS 2021 boundary (level 2) - GISCO distribution
evidence.method: GET full Europe NUTS2 GeoJSON (EPSG:3035 LAEA), then filtered feature NUTS_ID == EL62
evidence.schema_observation: FeatureCollection of NUTS2 regions; properties NUTS_ID, NAME_LATN; EL62 = 'Ionia Nisia' MultiPolygon (53 island parts), EPSG:3035 equal-area.
evidence.note: Full file 16,793,449 bytes; retained EL62 subset sha256 6b53f249bf425424c0f19eaba403c3183ef378432a6408a0e93e6d9d1fdca35d. EL62 polygon area = 2,304.87 km² vs published 2,307 km² (delta -0.09%, 1:1M generalisation). EL62 includes the Echinades islets (Petalas, Oxia, Drakonera …). Cross-checked against Eurostat GISCO NUTS 2021 level 3 (NUTS_RG_01M_2021_3035_LEVL_3.geojson, sha256 64cb81a6ecd3780aa506bfdb50069a1d3534e98d088b0123dfa95de730884290): point-in-polygon places Petalas, Oxia and Drakonera in NUTS3 EL623 'Ithaki, Kefallinia' ⊂ EL62 'Ionia Nisia' (see also data.europa.eu dataset estat-nuts-classification).

evidence.name: Natura 2000 Habitats Directive sites (pSCI/SCI/SAC) - geometry
evidence.method: GET ArcGIS REST query: where=MS='GR' AND SITECODE IN (envelope-intersecting set); returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, f=geojson
evidence.schema_observation: GeoJSON FeatureCollection; properties SITECODE, SITENAME, Area_ha, Area_km2, MS, SITETYPE. 34 sites whose envelope intersects the EL62 envelope.
evidence.note: Superset pull (34 sites = 18 GR22 + 16 GR13/GR21/GR23 mainland sites inside the bounding box). The mainland sites contribute 0 ha after the polygon clip; only GR2310001 (Acheloos delta, GR23-coded) overlaps EL62 - via the Echinades/Petalas islets (1,608.2 ha), which Eurostat GISCO NUTS 2021 places in EL623 'Ithaki, Kefallinia' (Ionian Islands, EL62). This confirms a GR22-only filter would under-count by 1,608 ha.

evidence.name: Natura 2000 Birds Directive sites (SPA) - geometry
evidence.method: GET ArcGIS REST query: where=MS='GR' AND SITECODE IN (envelope-intersecting set); returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, f=geojson
evidence.schema_observation: GeoJSON FeatureCollection; properties SITECODE, SITENAME, Area_ha, Area_km2, MS. 25 sites whose envelope intersects the EL62 envelope.
evidence.note: Superset pull (25 sites = 8 GR22 + 17 GR13/GR21/GR23 mainland sites inside the bounding box). Only GR2310015 (Acheloos delta SPA, GR23-coded) overlaps EL62 - the same Echinades/Petalas islets, 1,608.2 ha (Eurostat GISCO NUTS 2021: EL623 'Ithaki, Kefallinia' ⊂ EL62).

evidence.name: Data24 protected land % - derived spatial-join result
evidence.provider: IonianDTwin derivation (compute-data24-protected-land.py) over EEA Natura 2000 + GISCO NUTS
evidence.method: reproject Natura 2000 (4326) to EPSG:3035; intersect each site with EL62 land polygon; unary_union(Habitats ∪ Birds); % = union.area / EL62.area * 100
evidence.schema_observation: Audit JSON: el62_land_ha, habitats/birds/combined protected land ha, protected_land_pct, per-site overlap table, nongr22_sites_with_land_overlap.
evidence.note: RESULT: EL62 protected land = 38,640.51 ha = 386.41 km² of 2,304.87 km² = 16.76%. Habitats-only 22,049.2 ha; Birds-only 29,744.22 ha; union 38,640.51 ha (overlap de-duplicated). Terrestrial/marine split achieved by intersecting with the land polygon (marine 'THALASSIA ZONI' sites contribute only 25-99 ha each). Emitted as observation EEA_Natura2000:Data24:protected_land_pct:2026 (16.76 %, NUTS2/EL62).

evidence.name: EU Tourism Dashboard - 2024 release (indicator export)
evidence.method: GET CSV export (8.37 MB; 81,939 rows; 34 indicators x NUTS levels)
evidence.schema_observation: CSV columns: pillar, code, indicator, component, year, nuts_code_2021, unit, value. 34 indicators in 4 pillars (Basic descriptors, Green, Digital, Socio-economic).
evidence.note: Resolves Data25: "Share of accommodations in areas with high-nature value" (TOUR_DES_13) = 43 % for EL62 (2023); NUTS3: Zakynthos 59 %, Kerkyra 34 %, Ithaki-Kefallinia 34 %, Lefkada 57 %. Cross-checks Data24: "Share of protected/designated land" (TOUR_DES_12) = 16.57 % vs our Natura-2000 spatial join 16.76 %. Also supplies authoritative definitions for Data22 (Tourism diversity, TOUR_SOE_04), Data23 (Cultural assets density, TOUR_DES_14), Data30 (Average length of stay, TOUR_DES_05), Data32 (Dominant typology, TOUR_DES_07).
